name: orbit-card-stack
description: Collapsed profile deck that fans into an orbit on hover, then lifts the active card without changing its color or angle.
purpose: Lets a landing introduce a small studio or product team as a tactile stacked deck instead of a flat grid.
bestFor: campaign landings that need one featured profile at a time
avoidFor: large directories that need search or filters
dashboards where hover fan-out would fight the task
pages that must show every biography at once
